sloka: बध्यताम् एष तीव्रेण दण्डेन सचिवैः सह ।रावणस्य नृशम्सस्य भ्राता हि एष विभीषणः ॥६-१७-२९॥।।
transliteration: badhyatām eṣa tīvreṇa daṇḍena sacivaiḥ saha ।rāvaṇasya nṛśamsasya bhrātā hi eṣa vibhīṣaṇaḥ ॥6-17-29॥।।

translations.english: "Let us kill this Vibheeshana by punishment along with his ministers as he is the brother of cruel Ravana (said Sugriva to Rama)."
